code: # Use a short MCMC run for this illustrative example. check_iter <- 500 check_chains <- 1 # Create prior set.seed(2021) H <- 10 time_0 <- 0.5 + cumsum(rexp(H, 5)) # Use constant hazard model: hazard <- 0.15 prob_0 <- 1 - exp(- hazard * time_0) n <- rpois(H, lambda = 100 * time_0) y <- rbinom(H, size = n, prob = prob_0) x <- stan_map_summary_data(y = y, n = n, time = time_0,                            a_alpha = 1 / 3, a_beta = 1 / 3,                            b_alpha = 5, b_beta = 5,                            iter = check_iter, chains = check_chains,                            refresh = 0) #> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable. #> Running the chains for more iterations may help. See #> https://mc-stan.org/misc/warnings.html#bulk-ess  # Use prior in blinded BSSD analysis prob_arm1 <- 0.333 N <- 100 time <- 0.5 + cumsum(rexp(N, 100)) tmt <- sample(1:2, size = N, replace = TRUE,               prob = c(prob_arm1, 1 - prob_arm1)) hazard1 <- 0.15 hazard2 <- 0.25 prob <- numeric(length = N) prob[tmt == 1] <- 1 - exp(- hazard1 * time[tmt == 1]) prob[tmt == 2] <- 1 - exp(- hazard2 * time[tmt == 2]) y <- rbinom(N, size = 1, prob = prob) mix <- fit_mixture(x) w1 <- mix["w",] pi1_alpha <- mix["a",] pi1_beta <- mix["b",] w2 <- as.array(c(1)) pi2_alpha <- as.array(c(0.3)) pi2_beta <- as.array(c(0.3)) fit1 <- stan_bssd(y = y, time = time, prob_arm1 = prob_arm1,                   w1 = w1, pi1_alpha = pi1_alpha, pi1_beta = pi1_beta,                   w2 = w2, pi2_alpha = pi2_alpha, pi2_beta = pi2_beta,                   iter = check_iter, chains = check_chains, refresh = 0) #> Warning: Bulk Effective Samples Size (ESS) is too low, indicating posterior means and medians may be unreliable. #> Running the chains for more iterations may help.
